name: Route 46 Mountain Descent
summary: Descend the rocky mountain switchbacks of Route 46 south from the Blackthorn City gate. The trail is dominated by Rock/Ground-type Graveler (50% encounter rate) alongside Ground/Flying Gligar, powerful Donphan, swooping Fearow, and the rare Wigglytuff. A formidable static Slaking Lv. 45 blocks the lower pass — defeat or capture it to continue. Collect a Max Potion near the gate and TM12 Taunt tucked in the north-west corner of the route. Note: Route 46 requires the Waterfall HM Replacement tool to fully explore, which is obtained later in New Bark Town from Prof. Elm.

items.name: Max Potion
items.method: Found on the ground near the Route 46 gate entrance

items.name: TM12 Taunt
items.method: Found on the ground near the north-west corner of Route 46

static_encounters.location: Blocking the lower pass on Route 46
static_encounters.notes: Powerful 670 BST Normal-type with Truant ability (attacks every other turn). Save before engaging — excellent fusion body candidate. Can be captured in a Quick Ball on Turn 1 while Truant wastes its first action.
